events.description: A person leans over a bedridden individual and appears to forcibly restrain or smother them, with the victim raising hands in apparent defense or distress; the aggressor's posture and contact suggest non-consensual physical control.
A man leans over a person lying in bed in a dimly lit room; his posture and proximity suggest an aggressive or threatening interaction with a helpless individual.
A man in a robe leans over a sleeping woman in bed and places his hands around her neck, applying pressure in a choking motion while she remains unresponsive.
